claims.claim: Author-linked Ascend NPU implementation of AMNet at pinned June14 commit; same method family, no independent method or experiment count
claims.limitation: Commit date is not exact initial publication; repository owner is not all paper authors; two snapshot comparison does not prove ancestry.

claims.claim: 33 files are byte-identical to original project snapshot; six changed text files add device/AMP/seed/helper changes while model remains same
claims.limitation: No NPU execution/operator-coverage or numerical equivalence test; original project snapshot is later-dated and no migration chronology inferred.

claims.claim: NPU AMP wiring is conditional; all five released configurations disable AMP and demo entry has no explicit autocast/half/quantization
claims.limitation: No actual tensor/backend precision or device result measured, explicit device preference also bypasses local autodetection import/check.

claims.claim: RGB demo reads all lowercase JPG files into whole-clip tensor, invokes offline inference and saves reindexed uint8 PNG after return
claims.limitation: RGB recurrence is chronological; buffering future files is not proof each output uses future image information. Not a camera/video codec or constant-memory online entry.

claims.claim: Implicit event/IR branches and ConvLSTM/FFT remain; source also offers separate explicit persistent-state streaming API unused by demo
claims.limitation: RGB-only input does not remove implicit branch compute; actual operator support, state reset behavior and event timestamp causality not verified in execution.

claims.claim: Local shape arithmetic yields 166.11328125 MiB for 7 RGB FP32 1080p inputs and 63.28125 MiB for default one-layer FP32 H/C only
claims.limitation: Neither quantity is complete peak memory; CPU frame list, output stack, auxiliaries/activations/model weights not included. No phone/Ascend timing or energy result.

claims.claim: The public training/evaluator retains first-only batch4 evaluation and conditional missing-pretrain/frozen/strict=False limitations
claims.limitation: No claim authors ran these defaults; actual conference protocol and numerical impact unknown. Temporal loss utility not default-connected does not imply no temporal learning.

claims.claim: Two complete authored seven-frame input/output sets and one framework PDF inspected; no verifiable hardware/performance or temporal metric follows

anchors.locator: actually viewed framework and all paired contact stills

claims.limitation: Authored outputs are not newly reproduced; no GT, timestamps, frame rate, generating checkpoint/device log or continuous playback review.

claims.claim: Pinned archive has no binary checkpoint, LICENSE or frozen dependency/device environment; demo default expects external checkpoint and nonstrict model load

anchors.locator: same project pretrained entry retrieval limits

claims.limitation: Original project weight links not binary acquisitions; no weight deserialization, runtime test, source-license inference or claim private implementation absent.

claims.claim: Useful reference for state lifecycle and backend evidence requirements; not a demonstrated MobileIE-scale mobile cost solution
claims.limitation: Inference and proposed Gate3 comparisons only; no proven gain/new algorithm success or fair cross-hardware ranking.
